fields.name: status
fields.notes: frozen = real SSOT harvested/grounded; blocked = genuinely-absent SSOT only (DD-6)

fields.name: authority_tier
fields.notes: user_prd = C00 answer_state user fields; datasheet = vault/pulled datasheet (Tier-2); human_seed = C01 PDFs; mixed = combination

fields.name: files
fields.notes: real on-disk harvested/grounded SSOT artifacts ONLY; empty when blocked (天条2 no phantom)

fields.name: required_authority
fields.notes: named owner artifact needed to unblock a genuinely-absent field; null when frozen

fields.name: source_anchors
fields.notes: provenance for every frozen value (PRD field or datasheet page) (天条4)

fields.name: tier
fields.notes: provenance tier of this specific anchor

fields.name: source
fields.notes: for user_prd: answer_state.json document; for datasheet: MPN / blob path; for human_seed: PDF path

fields.name: locator
fields.notes: for user_prd: {section_id, field}; for datasheet: page number; for human_seed: PDF page

fields.name: note
fields.notes: what was harvested/grounded from this anchor

fields.name: layers
fields.notes: one entry per C-layer with harvested status

fields.name: vault_reused
fields.notes: MPNs whose already-ingested vault datasheet was reused (DD-3)
